
== CreateWebsite
steps: Create Unix user | Copy databases | Pull and check image signature | Start container in gVisor | Configure edge proxy | Get TLS certificate
long: false
$ install -d -m 0711 $DIR/homes $DIR/sites
$ install -d -m 0711 $DIR/homes $DIR/sites
$ chmod 0700 $DIR/homes/acme_x7k2
$ install -d -o root -g acme_x7k2 -m 0750 $DIR/sites/acme_x7k2
$ install -d -o acme_x7k2 -g acme_x7k2 -m 0750 $DIR/sites/acme_x7k2/app
$ loginctl enable-linger acme_x7k2
$ runuser -u acme_x7k2 -- mkdir -p -m 0750 $DIR/sites/acme_x7k2/app/public
$ systemctl start user@20001.service
$ runuser -u acme_x7k2 -- sh -c [ -n "$(ls -A "$1" 2>/dev/null)" ] || cat >"$1/index.php" sh $DIR/sites/acme_x7k2/app/public
  | <?php
  | // The default page of a new website. Upload your files to replace it.
  | header('Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8');
  | ?><!doctype html>
  | <html lang="en-GB">
  | <meta charset="utf-8">
  | <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  | <title>Website is ready</title>
  | <body style="font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; max-width: 40rem; margin: 4rem auto; padding: 0 1rem">
  | <h1>This website is ready</h1>
  | <p>Cloudfactory made this page. Upload your files with SFTP to replace it.</p>
  | <p>PHP <?= htmlspecialchars(PHP_VERSION) ?></p>
  | </body>
  | </html>
$ runuser -u acme_x7k2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/20001 podman pull --quiet ghcr.io/cloudfactory/frankenphp-php8.4:8.4.0-1
$ ip address replace 169.254.80.1/20 dev lo
$ systemctl daemon-reload
$ systemctl --user --machine=acme_x7k2@ daemon-reload
$ systemctl --user --machine=acme_x7k2@ restart cf-acme_x7k2.service
$ systemctl --user --machine=acme_x7k2@ is-active cf-acme_x7k2.service
$ systemctl --user --machine=acme_x7k2@ is-active cf-acme_x7k2.service
$ systemctl --user --machine=acme_x7k2@ is-active cf-acme_x7k2.service
$ systemctl --user --machine=acme_x7k2@ is-active cf-acme_x7k2.service
$ systemctl --user --machine=acme_x7k2@ is-active cf-acme_x7k2.service
$ systemctl --user --machine=acme_x7k2@ is-active cf-acme_x7k2.service

== SetRuntime
steps: Check image signature | Start new container on a copy | Health check | Switch traffic | Stop old container
long: false
$ runuser -u acme_x7k2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/20001 podman pull --quiet ghcr.io/cloudfactory/frankenphp-php8.4:8.4.0-1
$ systemctl --user --machine=acme_x7k2@ daemon-reload
$ systemctl --user --machine=acme_x7k2@ restart cf-acme_x7k2-b.service
$ systemctl --user --machine=acme_x7k2@ is-active cf-acme_x7k2-b.service
$ systemctl --user --machine=acme_x7k2@ is-active cf-acme_x7k2-b.service
$ systemctl --user --machine=acme_x7k2@ is-active cf-acme_x7k2-b.service
$ systemctl --user --machine=acme_x7k2@ is-active cf-acme_x7k2-b.service
$ systemctl --user --machine=acme_x7k2@ is-active cf-acme_x7k2-b.service
$ systemctl --user --machine=acme_x7k2@ is-active cf-acme_x7k2-b.service
$ systemctl --user --machine=acme_x7k2@ stop cf-acme_x7k2.service
$ systemctl --user --machine=acme_x7k2@ daemon-reload

--- $DIR/units/20001/cf-acme_x7k2-b.container (-rw-r--r--)
  # Managed by the Cloudfactory agent. The agent replaces changes to this file.
  [Unit]
  Description=Website 
  
  [Container]
  ContainerName=cf-acme_x7k2-b
  Image=ghcr.io/cloudfactory/frankenphp-php8.4:8.4.0-1
  Pull=never
  GlobalArgs=--runtime=/usr/local/bin/runsc --runtime-flag=platform=systrap --runtime-flag=network=sandbox --runtime-flag=ignore-cgroups
  Network=pasta
  PodmanArgs=--no-hosts
  Volume=$DIR/config/acme_x7k2/hosts:/etc/hosts:ro
  Volume=$DIR/sites/acme_x7k2/app:/app:Z
  Volume=$DIR/config/acme_x7k2/php-b.ini:/usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/zz-cloudfactory.ini:ro,Z
  Label=io.cloudfactory.website=01JBQ3Z5K8N6T4W2X9Y7R5P3M1
  Environment=SERVER_NAME=:8080
  Environment=CF_DOCUMENT_ROOT=/app/public
  EnvironmentFile=$DIR/config/acme_x7k2/env-b
  NoNewPrivileges=true
  DropCapability=all
  ReadOnly=true
  Tmpfs=/tmp
  UserNS=keep-id
  LogDriver=k8s-file
  PodmanArgs=--log-opt=path=$DIR/homes/acme_x7k2/website.log --log-opt=max-size=10mb
  Exec="php" "artisan" "queue:work"
  
  [Service]
  Restart=always
  TimeoutStartSec=300
  CPUQuota=100%
  MemoryMax=2147483648
  MemorySwapMax=0
  TasksMax=100
  
  [Install]
  WantedBy=default.target
--- $DIR/user@.service.d/zz-cloudfactory-stop.conf (-rw-r--r--)
  # Managed by the Cloudfactory agent. The agent replaces changes to this file.
  [Service]
  TimeoutStopSec=120
